title: add-benchmark-lab-profiling-baselines-and-reporting-pipeline-v95
author: Maya R. Singh
description: This PR adds the next iteration (v95) of the Benchmark Lab profiling baselines, representative workload runners, and an updated reporting pipeline. Motivation: we observed regressions in tail latency for long-context workloads during the last rollout; v95 collects consistent profiling baselines across mixed and multi-variant workloads, extends representative runners to cover streaming+tool-calling patterns, and wires results into the reporting pipeline for automated alerting. Changes are backwards-compatible with existing job configs. Checklist: - [x] Add new profiling baseline configs for 2.7B, 13B, and 70B model families - [x] Add representative workload runners (streaming, tool-calling, multi-turn) - [x] Extend reporting pipeline to emit per-model quantile latencies and cold-start histograms - [x] Add ingestion docs and example dashboards - [x] Add CI integration tests for runner correctness Notes: - Baselines are stored under benchmark-lab/profiles/v95/ and include YAML manifests and sample inputs. - Reporting pipeline updates are implemented in benchmark-lab/reporting/ with a new converter step that normalizes KV-cache and prefix-hit metrics. - Representative runners are packaged as dockerized workers with example Linear cards to reproduce locally. Related: Linear ENG-4831, ENG-4920; Support ticket SUP-8742 for regression triage.
commits: feat(bench): add v95 profiling baseline manifests for 2.7B,13B,70B
feat(bench/runners): add representative runner for streaming + tool-calling mix
feat(reporting): normalize kv_cache and prefix_hit metrics, emit p50/p90/p99 per-model
test(bench): add unit tests for runner input validation and CI job integration
docs(bench): add README and dashboards for v95
